milestones.title: Tested Modular Baseline
milestones.objective: Preserve current behavior while making the codebase testable, auditable, and easier to extend.

features.title: Build regression test harness for existing behavior
Create canonical example do-files covering current variables(), find(), and range() modes
Split parsing, selection, display, and variable-tracing logic into smaller internal programs
Document current supported and unsupported syntax patterns

milestones.title: Identification Logic Audit
milestones.objective: Strengthen the variable-derivation algorithm so it handles more Stata syntax reliably.

features.title: Audit current regex-based detection against generate, replace, egen, rename, drop, labels, loops, comments, and delimiters
Add edge-case tests for comments, compound quotes, line continuations, #delimit ;, and nested expressions
Define expected behavior for ambiguous or unsupported syntax
Improve diagnostic messages when tracing fails or is incomplete

milestones.title: Multi-file and Frame-aware Tracing
milestones.objective: Extend tracing from a single do-file and default frame to realistic multi-file Stata workflows.

features.title: Support ordered multi-do-file tracing where a variable is created in one file and modified in later files
Add frame-aware parsing for frame create, frame change, frame put, frlink, frget, and frame post patterns
Track variable lineage across file boundaries and frame context
Add examples showing multi-file and frame workflows

milestones.title: Performance and User Documentation
milestones.objective: Make the command fast, well documented, and easy for users to learn.

features.title: Profile current implementation on large do-files and multi-file projects
Optimize bottlenecks in parsing and line selection
Expand .sthlp documentation with examples, limitations, and returned results
Add user-facing example scripts and a quick-start workflow
